tasks.analysis: The seventeenth century was a golden age for Dutch painting, with artists producing genre paintings (depictions of scenes from everyday life), still lifes of fruit or flowers, and portraits of prominent citizens or community groups. Such paintings were typically intended not only to create visual pleasure but also to serve other purposes: to convey a moral lesson, to serve as legal documentation, or to commemorate an event or person. One important element in achieving these functions was the use of text—information expressed in words. 17 世纪是荷兰绘画的黄金时代，艺术家们创作了大量风俗画（描绘日常生活场景）、水果或花卉静物画，以及杰出公民或社群团体的肖像画。这类绘画通常不仅旨在带来视觉享受，还承载着其他功能：传递道德教诲、作为法律凭证，或是纪念某个事件或人物。而实现这些功能的一个重要元素，便是文字的运用 —— 即通过文字形式传递的信息。
